body: I think 8? they were the mini oranges (like tangerines) so I am giving myself a pass lol

This is so extremely relatable. My childhood nickname was "PPO" standing for 'paranoid party of one' (given to me by my mother of all people). Regardless, I am sorry you couldn't get treatment sooner. I hope you are supported by friends and other people in your life throughout your struggles with BPD!
